objective: Review the final cleanup commit on branch rune-rewrite (worktree /home/user/chkdsk-rune), range 0da10d6..HEAD, of the chkdsk rune rewrite.
constraints: Findings it claims to fix: N1 start-failure dialog shown for headless --snap runs (now early return on rune::is_headless(), error text on stderr); N2 selection moved by an update not scrolled into view in the sidebar, stale DiscoveryFailed notice persisting after disks are listed; N3 '15 segundos' hard-coded in present.rs (now retry_message(DISCOVERY_INTERVAL)). Known leftover: Notice::hint in src/ui.rs still hard-codes '15 segundos' (non-blocking)
Verify each fix and look only for regressions this diff introduced
Run cargo fmt --check, cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
Make no edits and no git writes
Report in under 250 words: N1-N3 closed/open with file:line, new findings with severity, gate exit codes and counts

criteria.text: States for each of N1-N3 whether it is closed, with file:line evidence
Any new blocking finding names file:line and a concrete failure scenario
Reports the gate commands with exit codes and test counts
